summary.text: Patrick Abrami is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 12, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the House from 2010 to 2022, representing Rockingham 19.

paragraphs.text: Patrick Abrami assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives in 2010, representing Rockingham 19, and left office on December 7, 2022; Susan Porcelli (R) succeeded him.
He advanced from the Republican primary for Rockingham 12 on September 8, 2026.
